It was so much more than I expected from something billed as a “concert.” They performed THE WHOLE DAMN SHOW with CHOREOGRAPHY and SETS and COSTUMES. And MULTIPLE PEOPLE IN EACH ROLE, sometimes on stage AT THE SAME TIME. Even with the forgotten lines and the unfortunate mic issues, I am so impressed with what they gave us with the limited preparation time they had. RENT has never been perfect but it will always be beautiful.
